summary: Staniel Cay Airport (TYM/MYES) is a small but important regional airfield serving Staniel Cay in the central Exuma chain of the Bahamas. It primarily handles inter-island flights, charter operations, and private aircraft, acting as a key gateway to one of the most picturesque parts of the Out Islands. The airport is well known among travelers as the main access point for visiting the world-famous swimming pigs at nearby Big Major Cay.
faqs:
Q: Which airlines serve Staniel Cay Airport?
A: The airport is primarily served by Bahamasair via connections from Nassau, along with various charter and private operators serving the Exumas.

Q: How far is the airport from Staniel Cay village?
A: The airport is located just minutes from the small settlement and the Staniel Cay Yacht Club, which serves as a hub for visitors.

Q: Is there a paved runway at Staniel Cay?
A: Yes, the airport has a paved asphalt runway suitable for small commuter aircraft and private planes commonly used throughout the Bahamas.

Q: Can I visit the swimming pigs from this airport?
A: Absolutely. The famous swimming pigs on Big Major Cay are just a short boat ride from Staniel Cay, making this the most common departure point for that excursion.
transport_tips: Most visitors arrange ground transfers directly through their hotel or the Staniel Cay Yacht Club, as there is no public transit on the island. Taxis are limited and should be pre-arranged when possible. Rental golf carts and boat charters are popular options for exploring the surrounding cays once you arrive.
local_tip: Pack your swimsuit and water shoes in your carry-on, as the boat to Pig Beach and Thunderball Grotto departs right from the marina near the airport, and most travelers head straight there upon landing before even checking into accommodations.
